summary: A market-wide AI/tech selloff (Nasdaq reported -5.5%) hit chips, networking and the construction and power names tied to AI capex; these are far above sticker, so price noise. In the buy range no dossier trigger was newly tripped today; SMCI's Q1 debt and cash-burn PROBLEM from yesterday stands (AVOID). To check: MELI margins, HRMY costs, AGX backlog, CRUS guide, PRDO and NRDS. My searches confirmed little, so several causes are unconfirmed. Not investment advice.

items.headline: No new filing today; Q1 trigger stands (OCF -$434M, debt $8.6B); stock -14%
items.why: Yesterday's PROBLEM verdict holds: dossier trigger 'debt above 3x FCF' tripped, OCF-negative quarter 1 of 4. Today's fall is part of the AI-hardware rout (price, METHOD 7). Still AVOID.

items.headline: Citi Sell call ($250→$207) still the only news; price $250 vs MOS $269
items.why: Downgrade is fear, not a story change (InvestED 249). Dossier trigger: ending-ARR growth <6% two years; check Q4 ARR and net new ARR. No breach today.

items.headline: -8% after Q3 as margins tighten; price $1,625
items.why: Earnings-driven fall; tighter margins touch the margin_stable marker. Check operating margin and credit-loss provisions in the 10-Q: growth spend (temporary, event check 3) or a moat issue? Details unconfirmed.

items.headline: -25% in a day after backlog fell to $2.5B (from $2.9B); price $344 vs MOS $25
items.why: Event checks 1 and 6: is award timing lumpy or demand rolling over? Price is 14x MOS, so nothing to buy at this price anyway. Check awards in the 10-Q.

items.headline: -12% after Q3 miss on higher costs; price $38.76 vs MOS $23.86
items.why: Single-drug (Wakix) business. Costs rose on a licence royalty; a search suggests the $1.0-1.04B revenue guide was kept (unconfirmed). Check gross margin and patent timeline (event checks 3, 6).

items.headline: Q3 beat, +7%; price $32.18 vs MOS $27.30
items.why: No dossier must-stay-true item is broken by anything found. Upside moves are never a reason to buy.

items.headline: Raised guidance, +4%; Street mean target cut 20% in 30 days
items.why: Target cuts are fear, not business news (InvestED 249). Guidance was raised, so the guidance-cut trigger is not live. Price $82 vs MOS $63.

items.headline: Withdrew bank-charter applications; target cut 21%
items.why: Dossier must #2: the bank-partner model survives regulation. Withdrawing the bank purchase keeps that model, but check why. No trigger yet; stays TOO HARD.

items.headline: -8% in a day, no company news found
items.why: No CSRC action in the headlines, so no dossier trigger. Likely market-wide (METHOD 7); Q3 results due Nov 19.

items.headline: -6%, financials hit by the market selloff
items.why: Market-wide move moves price, not value (METHOD 7). Price $76.90 vs MOS $27.75.

items.headline: -8% again though Q3 was a record; insider bought $105k
items.why: Energy names moved together (METHOD 7). Insider buy is context only. Check net debt (event check 5).

items.headline: -10% despite Q3 beat; reason unconfirmed
items.why: Beat yet sold off: check enrollment trend and any Dept. of Education item. Price $29.81 vs MOS $10.12.

items.headline: -14% / -10% / -9% with no headlines found
items.why: No news in inputs; cause unconfirmed. Check filings for guidance, customer or commodity news before judging.

items.headline: Q3 miss; price $11.18 vs MOS $12.70
items.why: Revenue and EPS miss. Check whether it is ad-market timing or lost share. Just inside buy range.

items.headline: -8% after a Q3 beat
items.why: Beat with no negative 8-K item and no business news found. Flag: owner earnings below 75% of net income, so check cash quality.

items.headline: -17% in 5 days, Street target cut 35% in 30 days
items.why: Large target cut with no headline found; reason unconfirmed, likely fear (InvestED 249). Find the firm and its reason.

items.headline: Weak Q3 revenue guide; Street target cut 14%
items.why: Guide cut at a customer-concentrated business. Check whether it is one-time (event check 3) or a customer loss (moat, check 6).

items.headline: BTIG downgrade to Neutral; results beat and guide raised
items.why: Downgrade after a beat is fear, not news about the business. On deck: price $264 vs MOS $142.

items.headline: -10% on a revenue miss; price $135 vs MOS $70
items.why: On deck, not in buy range. Check volume vs price and guidance in the 10-Q.

items.headline: -15% after a Q3 beat; price $6.86 vs MOS $5.10
items.why: Micro-cap that beat but fell: check customer concentration and backlog.

items.headline: NVDA, AVGO, MU, AMAT, LRCX, KLAC, MPWR, CLS down 12-23% in a day
items.why: Market-wide AI-trade selloff; coverage points to AI-spending fears and policy worries (causes unconfirmed). All far above sticker, so nothing to buy (METHOD 7).

items.headline: -32% / -28% / -16% in a day; STRL cites margin and cash risk
items.why: Above sticker so nothing to buy. Check margins and cash conversion: may be AI data-centre capex fear rather than company news.

items.headline: +45% on a record quarter and bigger buyback
items.why: Upside is not a buy reason. On deck at $228 vs MOS $195.
